title: She lived nearer to the Moon landing.
description:
She lived nearer to the Moon landing. The Great Pyramid was already about 2,500 years old when she was born. Apollo 11 was only about 2,000 years ahead of her. To Cleopatra, the pyramids were ancient history.

Finished for the pharaoh Khufu. By the time Cleopatra ruled Egypt it had already stood for roughly 2,500 years: older to her than she is to us.

Cleopatra was Greek. Her family, the Ptolemies, descended from a Macedonian general of Alexander the Great, and ruled Egypt for three centuries while speaking only Greek.

She was said to be the first of her line to bother learning Egyptian.

Sources:
- https://www.worldatlas.com/articles/so-cleopatra-lived-closer-in-time-to-the-first-lunar-landing-than-the-great-pyramids.html - WorldAtlas, read in full. Established that the Great Pyramid of Giza was completed around 2560 BC for the pharaoh Khufu, that Cleopatra lived in 30 BC, that Apollo 11 landed on 20 July 1969, that she was born roughly 2,500 years after the pyramid and roughly 2,000 years before the Moon landing, and that Cleopatra was a Greek Macedonian descended from Ptolemy, one of Alexander the Great's generals, whose line ruled Egypt for three centuries.
- https://study.com/academy/lesson/what-was-cleopatra-history-biography-facts.html - Via search summary. Established that the Ptolemaic rulers used only Greek while Cleopatra learned and spoke Egyptian, which is why she is commonly described as the first of her dynasty to do so.
